Do not count every sin of your male and female slaves, but cleanse us with the cleansing of your truth, and make our steps straight so that we walk in holiness of heart and do what is good and pleasing before you and before our rulers.

Yes, Master, make your face shine upon us for good in peace, so that we may be sheltered by your mighty hand and delivered from every sin by your uplifted arm, and rescue us from those who hate us unjustly.

Give harmony and peace to us and to all who dwell on the earth, just as you gave to our fathers when they called upon you in holiness, in faith and truth, so that we may become obedient to your almighty and glorious name and to our rulers and governors on the earth.
orientation: The Roman church is praying to God, continuing a long prayer of petition that began earlier in the letter, asking for forgiveness, cleansing, guidance, and peace for themselves and all people.

title: Prayer for rulers and final doxology
english: You, Lord, gave them the authority of the kingdom through your magnificent and indescribable might. You did this so that we, knowing the glory and honor you have given them, would submit to them and in no way oppose your will. Give them, Lord, health, peace, harmony, and stability, so that they may administer the leadership you have given them without stumbling.

For you, heavenly Lord, King of the ages, give to the sons of men glory and honor and authority over the things that exist on the earth. You, Lord, make straight their counsel toward what is good and pleasing before you. Then, as they administer in peace and gentleness with godliness the authority you have given them, they may obtain your mercy.

You alone are able to do these things and even greater good among us. We confess you through the high priest and protector of our souls, Jesus Christ. Through him be glory and majesty to you, both now and from generation to generation and to the ages of ages. Amen.
orientation: The Roman church is closing its long prayer to God, asking him to give health, peace, harmony, and stability to earthly rulers so that they govern blamelessly, and then offering a final doxology through Jesus Christ.

title: The letter's summary of its own teaching
english: Brothers, we have written to you at length about the matters that belong to our religion and are most useful for a virtuous life to those who wish to guide their course piously and justly.

We have touched on every topic: faith, repentance, genuine love, self-control, sound-mindedness, and endurance. We reminded you that you must please almighty God in holiness, with righteousness, truth, and patience. You must live in harmony, holding no memory of wrongs, in love and peace with earnest gentleness. This is how our fathers mentioned earlier pleased him: they showed humility toward God the Father and Creator, and toward all people.

We reminded you of these things all the more gladly because we knew clearly that we were writing to faithful and most distinguished men, men who have diligently examined the oracles of God's instruction.
orientation: The Roman church is closing its letter to Corinth by summarizing what it has written about faith, repentance, love, and the virtues, and why it wrote to such faithful and learned men.

title: Submission and the messengers sent to Corinth
english: It is right, then, for us to approach such great examples, bow the neck, and fill up the place of obedience. Then, once we have become quiet and left this vain faction behind, we may reach the goal set before us in truth without any blame.

For you will give us joy and gladness if you obey what we have written through the Holy Spirit and cut out the unlawful anger of your envy, according to the entreaty we made for peace and harmony in this letter.
We have sent faithful and sound-minded men who have lived among us blamelessly from youth to old age. They will be witnesses between you and us.
We have done this so that you may know that our whole concern, both past and present, has been for you to be at peace quickly.
orientation: The Roman church is closing its letter, urging the Corinthians to submit to its examples and announcing the faithful men sent as witnesses between the two churches.

title: Closing Prayer for Every Soul
english: Finally, may the All-Seeing God, the Master of the spirits and Lord of all flesh, grant to every soul that has called upon his magnificent and holy name faith, fear, peace, endurance, patience, self-control, purity, and sound-mindedness, so that they may please his name through our high priest and protector Jesus Christ.
He chose the Lord Jesus Christ, and through Christ he chose us to be a people of his own possession.
Through Christ be glory and majesty, might and honor to God, both now and for ever and ever. Amen.
orientation: Clement, writing from the Roman church, closes the letter with a prayer that God grant every soul called by his name the virtues needed to please him through Christ.

title: Send back the messengers in peace and joy
english: Send back to us quickly, in peace and with joy, the messengers we sent to you: Claudius Ephebus, Valerius Biton, and Fortunatus with them. Then they can report to us all the sooner the peace and harmony we have prayed for and longed for, and we too can rejoice all the sooner over your stability.

The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you and with all everywhere who have been called by God through him. Through him be glory, honor, might, and majesty to God, an eternal throne, from age to age, for ever and ever. Amen.
Letter of the Romans to the Corinthians.
orientation: The Roman church is closing its letter to the Corinthians, asking them to send back the three messengers quickly so that the Romans may hear good news of restored harmony.
